findings.title: robots.txt blocks AI crawlers
findings.evidence: The following AI bots are disallowed in robots.txt: CCBot, anthropic-ai

suggested_action.summary: Remove AI crawler blocks from robots.txt
suggested_action.detail: Allow AI bots to crawl the site to ensure inclusion in AI overviews and answers. Remove 'Disallow: /' for these User-agents.

findings.title: Missing canonical URL
findings.evidence: No <link rel="canonical"> tag found in the HTML <head>.

suggested_action.detail: Add a <link rel="canonical" href="..."> tag to prevent duplicate content issues.

findings.title: Invalid XML sitemap
findings.evidence: Sitemap at https://www.netflix.com/sitemap.xml could not be parsed as valid XML.

suggested_action.detail: Validate your sitemap against the standard XML schema.

findings.title: No JSON-LD structured data found
findings.evidence: extruct parser found 0 JSON-LD objects on the page.

suggested_action.detail: Add standard schema.org types like Organization, WebSite, or Product to help AI assistants understand your entities.

findings.title: Inconsistent on-page facts (Title vs H1)
findings.evidence: Title ('Netflix') and H1 ('Enter your info to sign in') have zero overlap in words, indicating potential confusion.

suggested_action.detail: Ensure your primary H1 heading and page <title> are topically consistent to give strong entity signals.

findings.title: Missing Organization/Brand Schema
findings.evidence: No structured data (JSON-LD, Microdata, RDFa) block of type Organization, Brand, LocalBusiness, or WebSite was found.

suggested_action.detail: Implement Organization schema to explicitly define your brand identity to AI search engine crawlers.

findings.title: Client-Side Rendered (CSR) SPA content hidden from basic AI crawlers
findings.evidence: Raw HTML contains only ~55 visible words because content relies on client-side JavaScript rendering.

suggested_action.detail: Use SSR (e.g. Next.js, Nuxt) or prerendering services so non-JS AI crawlers can read full page content.

findings.title: Missing OpenGraph tags
findings.evidence: og:title present: False, og:description present: True

suggested_action.detail: Add standard OpenGraph tags (og:title, og:description, og:image) for better snippet rendering across platforms and assistants.

findings.title: Facts locked in images (Missing alt text)
findings.evidence: 1 out of 1 images are missing alt text.

suggested_action.detail: If images contain facts or text, ensure they have alt tags so AI can extract the data.

findings.title: No date signals found
findings.evidence: No <time> tags or JSON-LD date properties were found.

suggested_action.detail: Use standard schema.org datePublished/dateModified and HTML5 <time> elements so AI knows the freshness of the content.

findings.title: Missing semantic navigation structure
findings.evidence: Did not find <nav> elements, role='navigation', or header menu containers with links.

suggested_action.summary: Use semantic HTML5 <nav> or ARIA navigation roles
suggested_action.detail: Wrap main navigation menus in <nav> tags or role='navigation' to provide clear structure for AI crawlers.

findings.title: No obvious Call to Action (CTA)
findings.evidence: Did not detect standard CTA actions (buy, sign up, contact, learn, try, search, connect) in interactive elements.

suggested_action.detail: Guide visitors and AI agents to primary conversion or engagement actions.

proactive_recommendations.title: Establish a consistent Knowledge Graph presence
proactive_recommendations.rationale: Even if structured data is valid, explicitly linking to a maintained Wikipedia or Wikidata entity acts as an anchor for AI to ground facts about the brand.
proactive_recommendations.suggested_action: Claim your Wikidata item, ensure Wikipedia is accurate, and link to them using JSON-LD sameAs.

proactive_recommendations.title: Publish an AI Policy / Terms of Service
proactive_recommendations.rationale: If you block some AI bots in robots.txt to protect IP, explicitly state what is allowed in a `/ai-policy` page. This ensures bots that respect advanced directives handle your content correctly.
proactive_recommendations.suggested_action: Add an AI Terms page and use <meta name="robots" content="noai"> if needed, rather than blanket disallows.
